        # Filter chains may be much deeper than Python's default recursion

        # Each frame is (target module, its parameter values, next pipe index).
        stack = [(target_name, target_values, 0)]
        while stack:
            current_target, current_values, pipe_index = stack[-1]
            pipes = self.pipes_by_target.get(current_target, ())
            if pipe_index >= len(pipes):
                stack.pop()

                                                   filter_values)):
